title: Hate Speech and Offensive Language Detection in Bengali

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating hate speech and offensive language in Bengali and Romanized Bengali tweets directed at specific gender groups (Men, Women, Trans) to enable evaluation of model bias.
Annotating hate speech and offensive language directed at specific linguistic communities (Bengali, Bihari) to facilitate bias measurement in detection models.
Annotating hate speech and offensive language directed at individuals based on national origin (Indian, Bangladeshi, Pakistani).
Annotating hate speech and offensive language directed at religious groups (Hindu, Islam) to identify targeted community abuse.
Annotating hate speech and offensive language targeting individuals based on political affiliations.
Annotating hate speech and offensive language specifically targeting disabled individuals.
Annotating hate speech and offensive language directed at specific castes (e.g., Dalit) to measure model detection capabilities across target communities.
